pages.text: Spirit Instinct is enabled on the $(thing)T$() wheel. When you have one heart remaining or a hit would be fatal, the form activates automatically, and you are left with half a heart.$(br2)The instinct costs 3 hunger points and will not activate if you don't have enough. If you exit the form after using it and take damage again, you will die.
When you exit a mob's body while taking its health, and the instinct is enabled, the disappearance effect activates immediately.
